name: starter-practice
label: Synthetic demo
alt: Scrolls Starter's practice exercise: a pointer drags the threshold slider until the drawn word INK survives and the noise-only control stays clean, turns on the gold outline of the drawn strokes, puts the pattern into the control so the result turns to a practice fail, then takes it out again and the pass returns.
caption: Synthetic demo: Scrolls Starter's known-answer practice, a drawn word with noise beside a noise-only control. No scan, model or text recognition.
command: python -m kit start --portable --out PAGE.html --no-open && python scripts/media/capture_web.py PAGE.html --out-dir FRAMES --actions scripts/media/captures/starter-practice.json --width 1280 --height 940 && python scripts/media/encode.py FRAMES --fps 12 --gif-fps 12 --gif-width 960 --mp4 docs/assets/starter/starter-practice.mp4 --gif docs/assets/starter/starter-practice.gif --meta scripts/media/captures/starter-practice.meta.json
